Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄), Yunmen Xiansheng Monastery address. Baiyu Si is the invited exact speaker who tells the assembly that to know the matter inside the inner hall they must ask the resident abbot-monk; Yunmen Wenyan is not the speaker or local section owner.

decisions.Kwic: 寒山拾得者對髼頭，似甚模樣。攜帚搭肩，縱情放蕩。

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄), image praise headed Hanshan and Shide (寒山拾得). Baiyu Si is the exact authorial speaker who depicts Hanshan and Shide as the dishevelled pair, with a broom over the shoulder and freely unrestrained; Bodhidharma belongs to the preceding image heading and is not this praise's speaker.
